description: Default permissions for the main window - grants the HTTP plugin so AI provider (BYOK) requests can be made from Rust, bypassing the WebView's browser CORS restrictions, plus the dialog/fs plugins for backup/CSV/Markdown/Anki export-import (see src/services/desktopFileStorage.ts). dialog:default covers the native open/save pickers; fs:default covers reading/writing whatever path the user picked through them - no broader filesystem scope than that is granted.
